# ChemistryDesk Precision Scientific Utilities
> Open-access, research-grade, offline-capable computational web engines for laboratory chemistry, material characterization, and benchtop solution preparation.

## Core Interactive Calculators & Tools

- [Offline Solution Molarity Studio & Hydrate Compensation Engine](https://chemistrydesk.vercel.app/molarity): 
  Two-way analytical mass solver to calculate required solute mass or final molarity. Automatically compensates for stoichiometric crystal hydration water (·nH2O, e.g., CuSO4·5H2O, FeSO4·7H2O) and manufacturer assay purity percentages. Includes 40+ bench standard reagent auto-lookup, dynamic GHS handling warnings, printable laboratory bottle labels, CSV recipe export, and instant academic citation drawers (BibTeX, ACS, APA 7, IEEE). Fully offline-capable via Progressive Web App (PWA) Service Worker caching.

- [Stock Dilution & Serial Ladder Studio](https://chemistrydesk.vercel.app/dilution):
  Solves C1V1 = C2V2 equations, multi-point analytical calibration standards, and geometric serial dilution ladders for spectrophotometry and analytical assays.

- [PXRD Scherrer Crystallite Studio](https://chemistrydesk.vercel.app/scherrer):
  Calculates mean crystallite domain dimensions from Powder X-ray Diffraction (PXRD) peak profiles using the Scherrer equation with full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) and instrumental peak broadening corrections.

## Technical Architecture & Offline Use
- Built for air-gapped wet chemistry labs and low-connectivity environments.
- Fully operable offline in modern web browsers using client-side Web Workers and Service Worker caching.
- Zero server-side data retention; all formulations run securely client-side in the browser.

## Citation & Academic Grounding
All ChemistryDesk tools provide built-in academic citation drawer components adhering to ACS, APA 7, IEEE, and standard BibTeX formats for inclusion in experimental methodology sections and supplementary information files.
